work_unit: Docker build-context hardening and authorized repository publication
evidence: Both service-specific Dockerfiles define their required inputs explicitly.
Existing ignore rules already excluded credentials, dependency folders, test sources, and local caches.
The remaining additions exclude non-runtime repository and local-development files from each build context.

dispatch.reason: The isolated, low-risk ignore-file update does not benefit from delegation.

acceptance_checks: Focused backend and frontend checks pass before commit.

outcome.backend_checks: passed: pytest, Ruff lint, Ruff format check, mypy
outcome.frontend_checks: passed: lint, typecheck, Prettier format check, production build
